title: api-gen-package configuration and design file
description: Settings for generate-api and the design of the generated back-office. Write it as api-gen.config.yaml (or .json/.js).

input.description: OpenAPI 3 or Swagger 2 document: path (relative to this file) or URL

output.description: Output directory, relative to this file (default ./src)

baseUrl.description: axios baseURL when utils/api.ts is first created

prefix.description: Path prefix before the resource name, e.g. /api/v1

groupBy.description: Group operations by first path segment or by first tag

envelope.description: Payload property of wrapped responses like { success, data }, or false to never unwrap

zod.description: Validate JSON responses at runtime with generated zod schemas

login.description: Generate a login page when the API has a sign-in endpoint (default true)

clean.description: Delete files from earlier runs that are no longer generated (default true)

ui.description: Look and wording of the back-office

title.description: Sidebar and login page title (default: the document's info.title)

labels.description: Override any UI string, e.g. addNew, save, signIn

primaryColor.description: Color of buttons and highlights, e.g. "#2563eb"

colors.description: shadcn/ui color tokens for light mode: primary, secondary, accent, destructive, background, foreground, muted, border, sidebar, ...

darkColors.description: The same tokens for dark mode

darkModeToggle.description: Light/dark switch in the sidebar (default true)

nav.description: Sidebar order, by resource name; resources not listed follow

resources.description: Per resource, by its name in the URL (users, product-categories)

description.description: Text under the list page title

hidden.description: Leave this resource out of the dashboard

columns.description: Table columns, in order; others are left out

hidden.description: Hide everywhere, or only in the table or the form
